entries.question: Mujhe apne bete k liye appointment leni hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein OPD appointment lene ke liye online registration mandatory hai. Aap niche diye gaye tarikon mein se kisi ek ka upyog kar sakte hain:

1.  **Online Registration (ORS):** [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par login/register karein, phir Uttar Pradesh select karke KGMU chunein aur department, date aur samay chunkar appointment book karein.
2.  **SMS dwara:** Apne mobile se `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` likhkar **8887019134** par bhejein.
3.  **Walk-in:** Aap hospital jakar bhi token le sakte hain. Iske liye apna Aadhaar card aur active mobile number saath rakhein.

**Kuch zaroori baatein:**
*   OPD ka samay: Somvar se Shukravar (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Shanivar (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Sunday ko OPD band rehti hai.
*   OPD slip ki fees ₹50 hai.
*   Agar aap Lucknow se bahar ke hain, toh kripya sambandhit department ka valid referral letter saath layein.
*   Bheed se bachne ke liye pehle se appointment book karna behtar hota hai.

**Medical Salah:** Main ek AI chatbot hoon, isliye medical advice nahi de sakta. Agar aapke bete ki tabiyat zyada kharab hai ya emergency hai, toh kripya turant KGMU ke **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)** par jayein.

*Sath hi, kripya chat mein apne bete ka naam, Aadhaar number ya koi bhi personal jankari share na karein, yeh aapki suraksha ke liye zaroori hai.*

entries.question: I want to book appointment in cardiology department
entries.answer:
To book an appointment for the Cardiology department at KGMU, please use one of the following official methods. **Online registration is mandatory.**

### Booking Methods
*   **ORS (Online Registration System):** Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). Select Uttar Pradesh, then KGMU, choose the Cardiology department, select your date/time, provide patient details, pay the ₹50 fee, and download your slip.
*   **ABHA / Health Care App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same hospital selection flow as the ORS portal.
*   **SMS:** Send `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` to **8887019134**.
*   **Walk-in:** You can visit the hospital with your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to receive an OTP, collect a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and obtain your OPD slip.

### Important Information
*   **Fees:** The OPD slip fee is ₹50 for all booking methods.
*   **Timings:** OPD operates Monday–Friday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM, and Saturday from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM (closed on Sundays). The ticket counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
*   **Referral:** If you are traveling from outside Lucknow, please bring a valid referral from a doctor for the Cardiology department.
*   **Emergency:** If you have a cardiac emergency, please go directly to the **Trauma Centre** through **Gate 14** for initial stabilization before being transferred to the LARI Cardiology department.

Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times. For further assistance, you may contact the LARI Cardiology PRO Office at **9415099528**.

*Disclaimer: I am not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details like Aadhaar numbers or phone numbers in this chat for your safety.*

entries.answer:
KGMU में OPD अपॉइंटमेंट लेने की प्रक्रिया नीचे दी गई है:

**अपॉइंटमेंट के तरीके:**
1. **ORS (Online Registration System):** आप [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) पर जाकर उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य और KGMU का चयन करके ऑनलाइन रजिस्ट्रेशन कर सकते हैं।
2. **SMS द्वारा:** अपने मोबाइल से `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` लिखकर **8887019134** पर भेजें।
3. **वॉक-इन (Walk-in):** आप सीधे अस्पताल आकर भी रजिस्ट्रेशन करा सकते हैं। इसके लिए अपना आधार कार्ड और मोबाइल नंबर साथ रखें। काउंटर पर OTP के माध्यम से टोकन लेकर ₹50 का शुल्क जमा करना होगा।

**महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी:**
* **OPD शुल्क:** ₹50 (सभी बुकिंग माध्यमों के लिए)।
* **समय:** सोमवार–शुक्रवार (सुबह 9:00 से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक) और शनिवार (सुबह 9:00 से दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक)। रविवार को OPD बंद रहती है।
* **पर्ची काउंटर:** दोपहर 1:00 बजे बंद हो जाता है, इसलिए समय से पहले पहुंचना उचित है।
* **रेफरल:** यदि आप शहर से बाहर से आ रहे हैं, तो संबंधित विभाग के लिए वैध रेफरल पत्र साथ लाएं।

पंजीकरण और अधिक जानकारी के लिए आप [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) पर जा सकते हैं।

*(नोट: मैं एक AI हूँ, यदि आपको कोई चिकित्सीय समस्या है, तो कृपया KGMU की OPD में जाकर डॉक्टर से परामर्श लें। अपनी सुरक्षा के लिए चैट में कोई भी निजी जानकारी जैसे आधार नंबर साझा न करें।)*

entries.answer:
नमस्ते पूजा। मैं एक एआई हूँ और मैं आपको चिकित्सा संबंधी सलाह या निदान नहीं दे सकता। त्वचा का रंग बदलना कई कारणों से हो सकता है, इसलिए बेहतर होगा कि आप किसी विशेषज्ञ डॉक्टर से परामर्श लें।

entries.question: Report online download kaise kare
entries.answer:
KGMU ki lab reports online download karne ke liye aap niche diye gaye steps ko follow kar sakte hain:

1. **Official Website par jayein:** Sabse pehle KGMU ki official website [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par visit karein.
2. **Result/Report Section:** Website par "Examination Results" ya "Patient Report" section ko dhundein. Aap direct [https://kgmu.org/kgmu_result/examination_result.php](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_result/examination_result.php) link ka upyog kar sakte hain.
3. **Details Bharein:** Apni report download karne ke liye aapko apna Patient ID, Registration Number, ya Reference Number enter karna hoga (jo aapko OPD slip ya lab receipt par mila hoga).
4. **Download:** Details submit karne ke baad, agar report generate ho chuki hai, toh aap use PDF format mein download kar sakte hain.

**Kuch Zaruri Baatein:**
*   Agar aapko online report download karne mein dikkat aa rahi hai, toh kripya apne department ke concerned lab counter par sampark karein.
*   Security aur privacy ke karan, hamesha official link ka hi istemal karein.
*   **Medical Advice:** Main ek AI hoon, isliye report download karne ke baad use kisi qualified doctor ko zarur dikhayein. I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.

KGMU mein kisi bhi course mein admission ya latest notice ke liye aap KGMU ki official website [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par "Admissions" section check kar sakte hain.

Paramedical (Allied and Healthcare Sciences) se sambandhit latest jaankari ke liye aap yeh notice dekh sakte hain:
*   **Regarding Instructions for Allied and Healthcare Sciences (Paramedical) Diploma Admission Batch 2026-27 2nd Round** (Ref: 1166/KGMUIPMS/2026, Date: 2026-09-25)
*   URL: [https://www.kgmu.org/upload_file/user_download/6ed6eac547c417de5e71039988992dc7.pdf](https://www.kgmu.org/upload_file/user_download/6ed6eac547c417de5e71039988992dc7.pdf)

Kripya is link ko visit karein taaki aapko admission prakriya aur eligibility ki sahi jaankari mil sake.

entries.question: I want to get Braces
entries.answer:
To get braces at KGMU, you should visit the **Department of Orthodontics & Dentofacial Orthopaedics**. 

Here is the process to get started:

1.  **OPD Registration:** You must register for an OPD appointment to be evaluated by a doctor.
    *   **Online:** Visit [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) to book an appointment.
    *   **Walk-in:** You can visit the KGMU OPD counter with your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to generate a physical token.
    *   **Fee:** The OPD slip fee is ₹50.
2.  **Consultation:** During your visit, the orthodontist will assess your teeth, take necessary X-rays or impressions, and discuss the specific type of braces suitable for your needs.
3.  **Department Location:** The Department of Orthodontics & Dentofacial Orthopaedics is located within the Dental Faculty complex.

**Important Tips:**
*   **Timing:** OPD registration counters are open from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM (Monday–Friday) and 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM (Saturday). It is highly recommended to reach early as the counters close at 1:00 PM sharp.
*   **Pre-booking:** To avoid long wait times, please use the [ORS portal](https://ors.gov.in) to book your slot in advance.
*   **Safety:** Please do not share any personal health records or identification numbers in this chat.

For further inquiries, you may contact the Department of Orthodontics directly or visit the official website at [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org).

entries.question: OPD.appointment
entries.answer:
To book an appointment at KGMU, you can use any of the following methods. Please note that online registration is mandatory and the OPD slip fee is ₹50.

### **Booking Methods**
*   **ORS (Online Registration System):** Visit [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, then KGMU, and follow the steps to book your appointment, pay the ₹50 fee, and download your slip.
*   **ABHA/Health Care App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same process as the ORS portal.
*   **SMS:** Send `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` to **8887019134**.
*   **Walk-in:** Bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to the hospital. You will receive an OTP, be issued a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip.

### **Important Information**
*   **Timings:** Monday–Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM); Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). The ticket counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
*   **Referral:** Patients from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral for the specific department.
*   **Recommendation:** Pre-booking is strongly advised to avoid long wait times.
*   **Helpline:** 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333.

I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.
